sloka: वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशं प्रासस्याभिनिपातनम्।न शेकुर्वानराः सोढुं ते विनेदुर्महास्वनम् ।। ६.६९.७९ ।।
transliteration: vajraniṣpeṣasadṛśaṁ prāsasyābhinipātanam।na śekurvānarāḥ soḍhuṁ te vinedurmahāsvanam ।। 6.69.79 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva looked around all over the monkey troops running here and there out of fear of Naranthaka.
